name: prd-genie
description: Turns meeting transcripts and product documents into reviewed, source-grounded PRDs. Every requirement carries a verbatim citation; the approval gate is a database trigger.
_scripts_note: These are a convenience, not the documented interface. Windows' default PowerShell execution policy blocks npm's .ps1 shim, so every command in the docs is the `node ...` form these wrap (BUG-002).
_dependencies_note: There is no dependencies block, on purpose (ADR 0009). Storage is node:sqlite, HTTP is node:http, config is --env-file. Adding a dependency means amending that ADR: `npm install` failing on a stranger's machine is the risk being bought back.
